verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents public Shares that anyone with a MotherDuck account in the same cloud region can attach, including users outside the publishing organization. Its docs show attaching a shared dataset (md:_share/hacker_news/...) to analyze it alongside your own data, so third-party data can be consumed inside the platform. However, nothing in the evidence describes a marketplace: no catalog, discovery, listings, or commercial third-party data providers, and no worked enrichment example. Missing for 10: a documented dataset marketplace or catalog with discovery, third-party provider listings, an enrichment workflow, and independent corroboration.
